mapper.select:
select distinct CLUSTER_ID from nyehms_cluster_partners ptr where current_process_Status = 17
and flux_MATCH_CD = #{STATUS_CODE}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NYEHMS_UPLOAD_CLUSTER upload WHERE upload.CLUSTER_ID = ptr.CLUSTER_ID AND RESOLVED_DATE IS NULL)
order by CLUSTER_ID asc
mapper.update: update nyehms_cluster_partners set current_process_status = 14, DISCARD_DATE = SYSDATE , DISCARD_BY = #{workerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where current_process_status = 17 and partner_cluster_id = (select partner_cluster_id from nyehms_cluster_partners where partner_id = #{documentId})
update nyehms_Sasdb_owner.ER_PERSON_CLUSTERS_STAGE set current_process_status = 14, REVIEW_UID = #{workerId}, REVIEW_DATE = SYSDATE where current_process_status = 17 and DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId}

merge into nyehms_cluster_partners b using nyehms_cluster_partners a on ( a.partner_cluster_id = b.partner_cluster_id and a.cluster_id = b.cluster_id and a.partner_id = #{p_document_id} ) when matched then update set b.current_process_status = #{CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS}, b.FLUX_MATCHED_STATENO = #{stateno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, b.FLUX_match_cd = #{UPDATED_MATCH_CD}, b.REVIEW_UID = #{p_worker_id}, b.REVIEW_DATE = sysdate
where b.current_process_Status = 17 and b.FLUX_match_Cd = #{ACTUAL_MATCH_CD}
mapper.select: select pdoc.stateno STATENO, std.DOCUMENT_ID, DIN, PERSON_CITY, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME, HOME_PHONE, CELL_PHONE, CLUSTER_ID, PERSON_COUNTY, ETHNICITY, MEDRECNO, BIRTH_SEX, PERSON_ADDRESS, PERSON_STATE, PERSON_ZIP, NYSID, CREATE_UID, PARTNER_ID, DOB_TEXT DATE_OF_BIRTH, TO_CHAR(DATE_OF_DEATH, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DATE_OF_DEATH, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') CREATE_DATE, BIRTH_COUNTRY, GENDER, RSN_NO_PS_MSG, RSN_PS_MSG, RACE_WHITE, RACE_BLACK, RACE_INDIAN, RACE_ASIAN, RACE_PACIFIC, RACE_OTHER, RACE_UNKNOWN, PARTNER_ASSISTANCE_STATUS, CONFIRMPATIENTPREP,CURRENTONPREP, case when exists (select 1 from nyehms_std_message_sent where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = std.document_id) then 'Yes' else 'No' end psMessageExist FROM STD_CLUSTER_PARTNERS std, person_doc_association pdoc WHERE std.document_id = pdoc.document_id(+) AND std.DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId}
select distinct PARTNER_FRNUMBER from NYEHMS_CLUSTER_PARTNERS where DOCUMENT_ID = #{document_ID}
select REF_COLUMN, LOOKUP_NAME, LOOKUP_CD from coded_partner_ref_data order by REF_COLUMN, LOOKUP_NAME asc

select doc.DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE "documentType", std.DOCUMENT_ID "documentId", FNAME FIRST_NAME, MNAME MIDDLE_NAME, LNAME LAST_NAME, FN_TO_CHAR(DOB_TEXT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DOB from STD_CLUSTER_PARTNERS std, document_locator doc where doc.document_id = std.document_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM std_cluster_doc WHERE demo_document_id = std.document_id and RSN_NO_PS_MSG is null) and not exists (select 1 from person_doc_association where document_id = std.document_id) and not exists (select 1 from NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = std.document_id)
select PARTNER_ID from STD_CLUSTER_PARTNERS where document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.update: update STD_CLUSTER_DOC set RSN_NO_PS_MSG = #{p_rejectReason}, OTHER_REASON = #{p_otherReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REVIEW_ID = #{p_worker_id}, REVIEW_DATE = sysdate where demo_document_id = #{p_document_id} and RSN_NO_PS_MSG is null

update STD_CLUSTER_DOC set RSN_PS_MSG = #{p_reason}, OTHER_REASON = #{p_otherReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REVIEW_ID = #{p_worker_id}, REVIEW_DATE = sysdate where demo_document_id = #{p_cluster_documentId} and RSN_PS_MSG is null
mapper.select: select LOOKUP_NAME, LOOKUP_CD from CODED_PART_CLUST_REF_DATA where REF_COLUMN = #{REASON_TYPE} order by Lookup_name asc
mapper.update: update STD_CLUSTER_PARTNERS set PERSON_ADDRESS = #{p_new_address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PERSON_CITY = #{p_new_city,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PERSON_COUNTY = #{p_new_county_fips,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PERSON_STATE = #{p_new_state,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PERSON_ZIP = #{p_new_zip,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where document_id = #{p_cluster_documentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update DOCUMENT_PERSON_ATTR set ADDRESS = #{p_new_address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDRESS_CITY = #{p_new_city,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COUNTY_FIPS = #{p_new_county_fips,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDRESS_STATE = #{p_new_state,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDRESS_ZIPCODE = #{p_new_zip,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where document_id = #{p_cluster_documentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select:
select case when RSN_PS_MSG is null then 'N' else 'Y' end RSN_PS_MSG, case when RSN_NO_PS_MSG is null then 'N' else 'Y' end RSN_NO_PS_MSG from std_cluster_doc where demo_document_id = #{p_docId}
and cluster_id_pk = #{p_clusterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update NYEHMS_UPLOAD_CLUSTER set RESOLVED_BY = #{p_workerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESOLVED_DATE = to_date(#{p_date,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') where CLUSTER_ID = #{p_clusterPartnerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
